title: Free energy and spectral edge of the SYK model
summary: We introduce a microscopic framework that gives the first rigorous derivation of the Schwinger--Dyson thermodynamics of the Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev model. For fixed, even interaction order $q\geq 4$, we prove that the annealed and quenched normalized pressures converge to the Schwinger--Dyson pressure $p_{{\rm SD},q}(β)$, at any fixed inverse temperature $β>0$.
